'''Sokor''' was a volatile [[Red giant/Legends|red giant]] [[Star/Legends|star]] at the heart of the [[Socorro system/Legends|Socorro system]]. It was theorized that, when the star blossomed into the red giant phase, it destroyed three inner [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to create the [[Thrugii Asteroid Belt]]; this same upheaval was believed to have knocked [[Neftali/Legends|Neftali]] into its irregular [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].

{{Star-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Sokor first appeared in  "[[Out of the Cradle]]," a story featured in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 2|second issue]] of ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] magazine that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[May]] of [[1994]].<ref name="Journal2">{{JournalCite|2|Out of the Cradle}}</ref> It was given the name "Sokor" in ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''.<ref name="Wretched">''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]''</ref>
